payload.title: End-to-end suites hold no proof of module boundaries: generated tokens default to every module, the only module-assignment workflow assigns the tenant admin and asserts only an array shape, and the fixture cannot build role A or role B, so D2, D5 and D6 can regress silently
evidence: e2e/helpers/jwt.helper.ts:109-118 (generated tokens default modules to ALL_MODULES and carry no per-module role)
e2e/tests/workflow/module-assignment.spec.ts:54-65 (returns early when the tenant has no module; assigns the tenant admin itself)
e2e/tests/workflow/module-assignment.spec.ts:112-114 ('verify access' asserts only that myModules is an array)
e2e/helpers/tenant.fixture.ts:160-167 (CreateTenantUserInput carries a tenant roleId only; no module grant)
payload.rule_violated: Plan section 7 mandatory cells (D2, D5, D6, revocation timing, header spoofing) and the repo hierarchy: a boundary that is not proven is not detectable.
payload.notes: Program module-boundaries, package PKG-41, release R11.
